svg.font-family: -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: BUILT — 3D Library + Schematics Library + reset everywhere (v0.39.0)
Two dedicated, browsable collection pages reachable from the header, plus a Reset on every moveable view.
1 · TWO COLLECTION PAGES (linked from the home header)
🧊 3D Library /3d
Every part with enough FLIS dimensions to render a representative
3D shape — 20,869 of them. Searchable, paginated grid; each card
is a live mini 3D thumbnail.
Click → drag-rotate · scroll-zoom · ⟲ reset · double-click reset
/api/threed?q=&limit=&offset= (ref_nsn with DIAMETER/LENGTH/…)
Self-contained renderer: family shape (cyl/hex/disc/box),
material/colour tint, depth-shaded — NOT a CAD model (grounded).
📐 Schematics Library /schematics
Every schematic / wiring-diagram document in the corpus — 1,093 of
them. Searchable by vehicle / TM / title / NSN; each card shows a
rendered page-1 thumbnail.
Click → built-in page viewer: prev/next, 🧹 clean, zoom ±, ⟲ reset
/api/schematics?q=&limit=&offset= (documents typed schematic/wiring)
Pages render on demand via /page; arrow keys page through.
Exploded-view RPSTL figures remain in the vehicle hub.
2 · RESET ON EVERY MOVEABLE / INTERACTIVE VIEW
Schematic page viewer
⟲ Reset clears tilt X/Y, zoom, and mirror back to the default view (sliders + buttons reset too).
Representative 3D viewer
⟲ Reset + double-click restores the default rotation + zoom.
3D Library cards
double-click or ⟲ in the modal resets rotation/zoom.
Schematics viewer
⟲ Reset returns zoom to 100%.
Triggered by the user demonstrating tilt with no way to reset. Every transform now has a clearly-labelled Reset; presentation-only and reversible (R1).
BUILT diagram. Dark (R3). v0.39.0 · 2026-06-02 · new pages: ui/threed.html, ui/schematics.html.
